visual_grammar.axes: heavy black spines, outward ticks, no decorative grid
visual_grammar.caveats: kept in manifest/status metadata rather than prose strips inside data panels

uncertainty.line_charts: mean ± sample SD across registered seeds or explicit model variants; rendered as shaded bands
uncertainty.bar_charts: mean ± sample SD rendered as whiskers; replicate points retained where available
uncertainty.single_reference: QE reference is deterministic and shown as a dashed line without an uncertainty band
uncertainty.missing_replicates: missing or non-finite rows are excluded; no imputation, synthetic seed, or extrapolation

figure1a_coordinate_semantics.coordinates: source-provided x_pca/y_pca from the common Cr-local SOAP/PCA fit; no task anchor, translation, rank equalization, or post-hoc movement
figure1a_coordinate_semantics.metric_warning: PCA axes retain the source feature-space projection; nonlinear UMAP/t-SNE candidates are kept separate and are not substituted into the PCA panel
figure1a_coordinate_semantics.task_clusters: very light convex hulls over the direct point rows shown in panel A, shown only as a visual aid and not used to move points
figure1a_coordinate_semantics.path_lines: not rendered in the clean primary PCA panel because the complete MD/NEB path set creates a spiderweb; source-provided path_key rows remain available in the embedding audit and manifest-linked source table
figure1a_coordinate_semantics.marker_area: distance_to_training, percentile-normalized; larger area means farther feature-space OOD
figure1a_coordinate_semantics.point_hue: task group color, matching the original R03 Figure 1A grammar
figure1a_coordinate_semantics.point_shape: task group marker; source-split coverage remains explicit in panel C
figure1a_coordinate_semantics.not_confounded_with: rms_delta_A remains a structural Cr-shell distortion field in the source table and is not relabelled as OOD

notes: This is an additive pre-import review package; the source PR and historical figure outputs are not overwritten.
All blocked panels are explicit placeholders; no synthetic observations are used.
SCF-warning, endpoint-only proxy, legacy and provisional states remain separate.
Every aggregate line panel uses a finite replicate ensemble with a shaded mean ± sample SD band; every aggregate bar panel uses mean ± sample SD whiskers.

Figure 1A retains the source-provided raw SOAP/PCA coordinates and the first-version foreground point contract: MLIP self-relaxed NEB/sliding rows remain complete in panel C but are not rendered as hundreds of foreground scatter markers.
The clean primary PCA panel omits the full source path-line set to avoid a spiderweb; path-aware diagnostics remain in the source table and pre-cleanup snapshot.
Superseded UMAP and t-SNE candidates are preserved only in the pre-cleanup snapshot commit; no post-hoc task translation is used in the canonical PCA panel.
Figure 1A point area uses distance_to_training for OOD and does not relabel Cr-shell structural distortion as OOD.
Figure 2 C/F clusters are sourced from the complete parity summary; one provider-backed auxiliary frame archive is omitted only from the non-summary scatter layer.
Figure 6 B/C remain complete for all five families and 15 model IDs from the status table; provider-backed auxiliary line files are omitted only where they do not materialize locally.
The selected-figure build intentionally does not create the full-package tables directory; use the PR package manifest and source hashes for provenance.
